main_text.p: dicio si stabit & probabitur no-stra hæc opella, næ caussa[?] non erit, cur de cæterorum eruditorum calculis aut desperemus, aut multū simus solliciti. quod enim ille olim de Platone, id ego non minori iure nunc de te, Unus tu mihi instar omnium. Nam & is es tu, in quo uno cū-ctas habitare virtutes, quas in aliis mirari solemus singulas, uno omnes ore pridem fatentur. Te quondam in media patria, & in oculis tuorum civium Reipu. gubernacula integritate, iusti-tia, & moderatione summa inter præcipuos tractantem, laudibus in cœlum omnes ferebant. page.notes: The signature mark "ā 5" is partly worn; the 5 is uncertain. "cauffa" is read as "caussa" (long s doubled), marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "Reipu." is kept as printed, with its full stop. Ends mid-sentence; the text continues on the next page.
